samplesheet.description: S3 URI of a TSV with header cell_id<TAB>...; donor is the cell_id prefix before '_'

bam_prefix.description: S3 prefix (trailing /) holding <cell_id>.bam and <cell_id>.bam.bai (align workflow output bam/)

container_copynumber.description: ECR URI of the cnv-cfs/copynumber image

bin_sizes.description: Comma-separated bin sizes in kb; default 200,500,1000

cnaware.description: CN-aware GC/mappability correction YES/NO; default NO

mappability.description: Correct by mappability YES/NO; default YES

reptiming.description: Replication-timing correction YES/NO (upstream applies it only at 30/50 kb); default NO

downsampling.description: nrpbpcc threshold for the powered flag; default 15

total_reads.description: fitting_absCN --total.reads; cells at or below are not fitted and are listed in failed_cells.tsv; default 20000

relcn_prefix.description: S3 prefix (trailing /) of a previous run's relCN/ folder, for reuse_relcn

reuse_relcn.description: Comma-separated donor_bin tags (e.g. P07_200) whose relative CN is reused from relcn_prefix
